title: The Queue (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar spoken word dry wit cabaret 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan male vocal absurdist observational comedy patient warm
lyrics:
[Intro - piano, patient and steady]
There are people who are good at queuing
And there are people who are not
I want to tell you about a man
Who was genuinely excellent at it

[Verse 1]
He arrived early
He positioned himself correctly
He maintained the appropriate distance from the person in front
He did not look at his phone

When someone cut in, he noted it quietly
He did not make a scene
A scene would have been inappropriate
He was in a queue

He moved forward at the correct pace
Neither too fast nor creating a gap
He arrived at the front in seventeen minutes
Which was expected

[Pre-Chorus]
The person behind the counter
Looked up and said
Can I help you
And he opened his mouth

[Chorus]
He had nothing to buy
He had absolutely nothing to buy
He had nothing to buy
He had queued out of habit, he realised
He was very good at the queuing
He had not considered the buying
He stood at the front of the queue
With nothing to buy

[Verse 2]
He considered his options
He could buy something he did not need
He could apologise and leave
He could ask for directions somewhere he already knew

He chose a small bottle of water
He did not need it
It cost two dollars and forty cents
He had the exact change

[Bridge - spoken, reflective]
He drank the water on the way to the car
It was fine
He is not sure what he learned from this
He thinks it may be something about purpose
He queues less now
But when he does queue, he brings a list
The list has one item on it
Usually bread

[Chorus]
He had nothing to buy
He had absolutely nothing to buy
He had nothing to buy
He had queued out of habit, he realised
He was very good at the queuing
He had not considered the buying
He stood at the front of the queue
With nothing to buy

[Outro - piano, gently satisfied]
He still has the receipt for the water
He is not sure why
He filed it under W
Behind the warranty for the filing cabinet
